service.description: Moves the switch from BOSS_PRICE_SALES (15.00) to BOSS_PRICE_NEXT (16.00, "Scheduled next price") to the first day of the month after next at 00:00, so the demo's next price is always ahead of the load; loading again moves it. Specs that assert a price read it as of a fixed date. Only data loading or a system administrator may run it.
